messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · P1 · KV cache reuse correctness anomaly detected. Alert: increased payload corruption and cross-request token leakage on /v1/generate (region-us-west). PagerDuty routed to @maria (oncall). Incident id INC-20678.

maria (oncall): Ack. I'm looking. Paging @ben and @lucy. Initial hypothesis?

ben (engineer): On it. I see a signature pattern in the logs: many responses contain fragments from previous requests. kv_cache metrics show normal hit rate but seq_offset mismatches in traces. pulling example logs now.

ben (engineer): log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:12:03Z request_id=abc123 model=gpt-redwood seq_start=461 seq_end=472 kv_hit=true last_seen_seq=482 cached_kv_key=enc:23a9
response: "...user prompt A..." + "...tail of previous request B..."
```

ajay: We rolled continuous-batching + KV reuse changes ~3h ago in prod. Could be a regression in the reuse gating (seq checks).

sophia: If seq_offset check is skipped, cached KV pages can be reused across different request streams. Two quick mitigations: 1) disable continuous-batching (hotfix) 2) force per-request KV isolation until we patch.

maria (oncall): Agreed. Prioritize hotfix to stop customer impact. @deploy-bot can you roll a config change to disable reuse?

deploy-bot: Received command. Initiating config rollout: setting KV_CACHE_REUSE=false on inference-service-prod. Rolling update started: https://deploys.redwood/example/roll/20678

lucy (sre): Also recommend immediate eviction/flush of existing KV cache pages — we need to remove stale pages that are already tainted. There's an admin endpoint: POST https://admin.prod.redwood/internal/kv_cache/flush (auth required). I'll call it once deploy toggles are live.

ben (engineer): I'm preparing a small patch to add strict seq_offset validation in the reuse path and a defensive assert that rejects cached pages when request.stream_id != cached.stream_id. Will push a canary to 3% after toggle.

customer-support: Heads up — we already have 2 inbound support tickets describing garbled completions and leaked content. Notifying impacted customers (Acme, NovaRetail). Preparing a brief status message to send once we have a mitigation confirmed.

maria (oncall): After deploy-bot confirms toggle, do the flush. Then post-mitigation checks: run the end-to-end test suite against a synthetic mix of short/long requests and verify no cross-request leakage for 30m.

deploy-bot: Toggle complete: KV_CACHE_REUSE=false applied to inference-service-prod (all pods restarted). Rollout id 20678.

lucy (sre): Flushing KV cache now. curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" https://admin.prod.redwood/internal/kv_cache/flush -> 200 OK.

ben (engineer): Canary patch deployed to 3% (add seq check + stream_id guard). Observing sampled traffic. I also instrumented extra debug logs for seq offsets.

ben (engineer): Early canary results: no observed leakage in sample traffic for ~12 minutes. KV hit rate dropped ~8% (expected), latency +3-8ms.

ajay: Good. What's the rollback plan if canary shows perf cliff?

sophia: We have two levers: 1) re-enable per-request mode permanently (costly) 2) roll back the continuous-batching change that introduced the bug (fast rollback to previous container image). Keep both ready.

customer-support: Sending template update to impacted customers now: short note + apology + ETA for full postmortem once fixes validated.

maria (oncall): Handoff: I need to step out in 20m. @ajay you take next oncall for incident. Ben will continue as incident lead for engineering. Lucy please monitor infra metrics. Keep this channel updated every 10 minutes.

ajay: Acknowledged. I'll take over. Ben — if canary looks good for 30m, what's our timeline to lift the emergency toggle?

ben (engineer): If canary remains clean for 30m and integration tests pass, we can promote the patch to 50% then 100% over next 45m. After full promotion, we can safely re-enable safe KV reuse (with the new validation) or keep reuse disabled while we run extended perf e2e. I'll post detailed plan in 5m.

lucy (sre): Monitoring: synthetic leakage checks passing, error budget currently stable. I'll run a sweep across regions after full promotion.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: from 3% -> 20% started.

ben (engineer): Noted a minor regression in throughput at 20% canary (~2% lower). Could be extra validation cost. I'll tune the gating to avoid unnecessary validation for stream-local requests.

maria (oncall): Update for pager duty: Incident status -> Mitigated (customer impact reduced) after KV reuse toggle + flush. Still investigating root cause (missing guard in reuse path). Will open INC-20678 postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20678 status changed to MITIGATED by maria. Next action: postmortem assigned to ben.

ben (engineer): Creating a PR with fix + tests to assert no cross-request reuse and a unit test that reproduces stale seq_offset reuse. Will include perf regression bench.

ajay: I'll own the post-incident communications with SRE and Support for the next 24h. Leave handoff notes here when you have them.

customer-support: Customers updated. One customer asked for a timeline; we gave 4-6h for full verification + postmortem.

maria (oncall): Handing off completely to @ajay. I'm going offline now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ajay: Taking over. Please post any remaining logs/debug info to INC-20678 ticket and close out once PR is merged and canary fully rolled to 100%.

ben (engineer): Will follow up with root cause writeup and a recommended long-term mitigation: stronger stream scoping in KV namespace + periodic integrity checks and per-page seq fingerprints.

incident-bot: NOTE: Create follow-up tasks: 1) postmortem INC-20678 (owner: ben) 2) perf validation job (owner: eng-runtime) 3) customer communication draft (owner: customer-support).

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: canary -> 100% promoted, inference-service-prod now running patched image v2026.03.15-fixseq.

ajay: Closing notes: mitigation validated 45m after initial toggle, no new tickets reporting leakage. We'll keep increased sampling for 24h. Thanks team.

maria (oncall): Great work. Please link the postmortem here when ready.

ben (engineer): Will post the detailed postmortem + diff and tests in INC-20678 within 24h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-20678 moved to RESOLVED (monitored) by ajay.
